title: Time Management & Project Sequencing
intent: formative · Communication & Reflection (Applying) · click through the process
statement: Turn a large module into timed, sequential milestones — with slack for when things go wrong.

steps.title: Break into milestones
steps.text: Split the work into deliverable chunks with clear done conditions.

steps.title: Estimate each honestly
steps.text: Guess the time each will really take, then be honest about your optimism.

steps.title: Sequence by dependency
steps.text: Order milestones so nothing waits on work that has not started.

steps.title: Add contingency
steps.text: Build in slack for the step that will slip — because one always does.

steps.title: Review and adjust
steps.text: Check progress against the plan regularly and re-sequence as reality bites.

feedForward.text: List your next three milestones with a date each, and mark which one everything else depends on.
